visitors.title: Archive Curator
lines: The Atlas earns its scale by refusing to fill silence with invention.
Meridian becomes legible only after the people inside it can no longer interrupt the composition.
The chronology is not decoration. Every gap marks an unresolved authority problem.
visitors.repeated: The Atlas earns its scale by refusing to fill silence with invention.

visitors.title: Game Visitor
lines: The tiny town is convincing because the rules are local before the scenery is local.
Smudge collects scale itself, not merely clutter.
This wing understands that place has mechanics. Duncan is not wallpaper.
visitors.repeated: The tiny town is convincing because the rules are local before the scenery is local.

visitors.title: Myth Systems Researcher
visitors.role: Myth Systems Researcher · West Systems Workshop
lines: The control room is frightening because it records authority instead of flattering it.
The familiar is not a mascot. It is a visible state machine with opinions.
He builds myth the way other people build databases, and somehow both remain true.
visitors.repeated: The control room is frightening because it records authority instead of flattering it.

visitors.title: Local-first Engineer
visitors.role: Local-first Engineer · East Local Systems Lab
lines: Relay Link does not pretend a dropped bridge is still connected. That is rarer than it should be.
DexDictate treats privacy as architecture, not a footer promise.
The discipline is the point: local, inspectable, recoverable, and honest about failure states.
visitors.repeated: Relay Link does not pretend a dropped bridge is still connected. That is rarer than it should be.

visitors.title: Forensic Analyst
visitors.role: Forensic Analyst · East Local Systems Lab
lines: The evidence trays are more important than the tool count.
A local model is useful here only if the chain of custody remains visible.
Even the investigative tools are shaped by consent, scope, provenance, and restraint.
visitors.repeated: The evidence trays are more important than the tool count.

visitors.title: Memory Architect
visitors.role: Memory Architect · East Local Systems Lab
lines: The archive does not resolve contradictions just because retrieval found both of them.
A source-grounded answer is a path through rooms, not a sentence from nowhere.
DexVault makes the underlying fear explicit: losing the thread is a form of damage.
visitors.repeated: The archive does not resolve contradictions just because retrieval found both of them.

visitors.title: Accessibility Visitor
lines: The scent markers are care translated into spatial design.
The dog is allowed to remain difficult, specific, and real.
Dexter is sacred here, but not sentimentalized. Blindness changes the route, and the room honors that.
visitors.repeated: The scent markers are care translated into spatial design.

visitors.title: Floor Docent
lines: The museum is organized by governing problem, not by date.
You are allowed to disagree with the labels. The artifacts are the stronger evidence.
Please notice that the installations change in place. Nothing is a slideshow pretending to be a room.
visitors.repeated: The museum is organized by governing problem, not by date.

visitors.title: Gallery Attendant
lines: Please keep the path clear around the floor-plan kiosk.
No, the dog does not speak. The room is still listening.
The central installations are interactive. The walls are not touchscreens.
visitors.repeated: Please keep the path clear around the floor-plan kiosk.

visitors.title: Installation Conservator
lines: This installation has more moving state than most museums would permit.
Maintenance is part of the interpretation when failure states are the subject.
The wall reliefs are intentionally fixed. Their orientation belongs to the building.
visitors.repeated: This installation has more moving state than most museums would permit.

visitors.title: Design Student
lines: Look at the ring: it is material, not symbolic anatomy.
The museum keeps refusing the easiest visual metaphor.
The official-versus-actual switch is doing more narrative work than a whole cutscene.
visitors.repeated: Look at the ring: it is material, not symbolic anatomy.

visitors.title: Systems Student
lines: The six-month pacing is the exhibit. The station model is only the evidence.
The strongest interaction here is being forced to wait.
The system is teaching canon through state transitions instead of a lore dump.
visitors.repeated: The six-month pacing is the exhibit. The station model is only the evidence.

visitors.title: Seated Sketcher
lines: The ferry is a clock that the player has to inhabit.
Rain should change the hand before it changes the color palette.
I am drawing the grade of the street, not the skyline. The grade is the mechanic.
visitors.repeated: The ferry is a clock that the player has to inhabit.

visitors.title: Visiting Architect
lines: The portal frames make the canon wing feel earned.
This building finally behaves like a place that expects return visits.
The good choice was turning the introduction into a vestibule rather than a menu.
visitors.repeated: The portal frames make the canon wing feel earned.

visitors.title: System Pilgrim
lines: The sacred part is not the glow. The sacred part is the accommodation.
Dexter is treated as a governing presence, not a mascot.
The sanctuary is convincing because it is specific: blindness, scent, route, rest.
visitors.repeated: The sacred part is not the glow. The sacred part is the accommodation.

visitors.title: Continuity Researcher
lines: The most interesting thing here is that the labels do not overpromise.
The museum reads like a self-portrait made of methodologies.
He keeps building systems that admit contradictions into the room.
visitors.repeated: The most interesting thing here is that the labels do not overpromise.

visitors.title: Media Researcher
lines: There is something refreshing about a museum that lets the artifact stay a little ugly.
The more specific the canon gets, the less decorative it feels.
The outreach film folio on the wall reframes the whole war section.
visitors.repeated: There is something refreshing about a museum that lets the artifact stay a little ugly.
